description: Fasi operative - Piani di Protezione Civile - Regione Piemonte is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by presidi.serviziprotciv.regione.piemonte.it. The dataset represents the operational phases related to the municipalities and bodies of the vast Area, i.e. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Operational phases — Civil Protection Plans — Piedmont Region" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include emergenza, opendata, protezione civile, ARPA, Fasi operative, bollettino. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
